about: Harness profiles for scripts/run_evals.py. `argv` is one invocation; the standalone tokens {arm} and {extra} expand to the arm's extras and the operator's --extra-arg values, {plugin_dirs} expands to one `--plugin-dir <module>` pair per principal module, and {prompt}, {model}, {workdir}, {max_turns} are substituted inside any token. An arm absent from `arms` cannot run on that profile. No profile widens a tool permission: pass one with --extra-arg.

claude.note: --plugin-dir loads the generated modules for the with arm; the without arm loads none. Run from a fixture whose project settings enable no plugin.

codex.note: Codex loads the quenching-codex plugin from its own installation, so only the with arm exists here.

opencode.note: Flags from OpenCode's documented `opencode run`; the command surface port is spec 2038, so only the with arm exists until it lands.
